package.name: valid8_cell_moveit_config
package.description:
Valid8 Robot Cell MoveIt Configuration Package
Contains MoveIt 2 configuration for the Valid8 workcell: - SRDF (Semantic Robot Description Format) - Kinematics configuration (KDL, IKFast, or other solvers) - OMPL planning configuration - Joint limits with acceleration limits - Controllers configuration for UR Robot Driver - Launch files for move_group and RViz
To regenerate this configuration, use MoveIt Setup Assistant: ros2 launch valid8_cell_moveit_config setup_assistant.launch.py
Based on Universal Robots ROS 2 custom workcell tutorial: https://docs.universal-robots.com/Universal_Robots_ROS_Documentation/doc/ur_tutorials/my_robot_cell/doc/build_moveit_config.html
